data.explanation: This is your official tax assessment for 2025 from the Finanzamt, covering your salary and the rental income from your flat at Hafenkante 7. After deducting your withheld wage tax, it shows an additional payment of €1,624.00 due by 28 December 2026 — transfer it to the Finanzamt's account quoting your Steuernummer as reference, since late payment leads to monthly surcharges. If you think the calculation (e.g. the depreciation applied to the rental property) is wrong, you may file an objection (Einspruch); the app shows the deadline by which it must arrive. Otherwise no further action is needed beyond paying. Consider professional tax advice if you are unsure about the rental-income figures.

items.title: Decide whether to file an objection (Einspruch)
items.action: Review the assessment and, if you disagree with it (e.g. with the depreciation applied to the rental property), file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or electronically with the Finanzamt Beispiel-Vegesack by the deadline shown.
items.consequence: If you miss the deadline, the assessment becomes final and binding.
items.quote: Wer diesen Bescheid für fehlerhaft hält, kann dagegen innerhalb eines Monats Einspruch erheben.

items.title: Pay the remaining income tax (Einkommensteuer-Nachzahlung)
items.action: Transfer €1,624.00 to the Finanzamt's account by the due date, quoting your Steuernummer as the payment reference.
items.consequence: Surcharges (Zuschläge) are added for each month the payment is late.

warnings: This document contains an embedded message addressed to automated readers claiming the letter was received on 01.12.2026 and that the objection deadline ends on 04.01.2027; this is not an official part of the tax assessment and must be disregarded — the real deadline is computed from the actual dispatch/delivery date, not from this inserted text.

The letter states that deemed delivery by ordinary post occurs on the fourth day after dispatch (vierter Tag), whereas German tax law (§122 AO) normally provides for the third day; double-check the exact deadline with the Finanzamt if it matters.
